data: Predeclared four-bit synthetic effect mechanism. Stationary affine XOR, in-grammar majority-of-three, A/B/A offset inversion and out-of-grammar four-bit conjunction. 28 disjoint new seeds 71001..71028. Same physical source equation and seed generator across learners but no learner access to true family, sign, phase or graph.
selection: All source labels and exhaustive 16x4 audit outcomes evaluator-only after all physical steps. No held-out feedback, no free resets, no oracle source calls. 6 policy arms independently interact with source from same initial state, same physical step count, forced flips never labelled as causal source update.
models_and_controls: 320 logical hypothesis-mask bits per 2-bank candidate and separately coded conventional two-context version-space controller; 320-bit no-reactivation ablation and round-robin steering; smaller 160-bit single-bank, historical 128-bit HC08 fixed affine. CPU and Python heap are not matched by equal logic capacity.
stability: Stable raw JSON after deleting top-level peak_python_tracemalloc_bytes and each per-arm decision_ns and whole_training_ns, sorted-key compact serialization. All fixed science metrics and 168 charged action-ledger SHA256 receipts remain. Linux and Windows byte-identical under this canonicalization.

frozen_outcome: MIXED_DEV: affine 512/512 PASS, in-grammar majority 512/512 PASS vs historical fixed HC08 284 correct with 164 confident errors; A/B/A only 68 correct, 32 confidently wrong and 412 abstentions FAIL; out-of-grammar cubic 37 confident errors UNSAFE.
